mission: Complete unfinished USGS-matched canonical and registry discipline records with captured definitions and explicit taxonomy
source_policy: USGS is the primary publisher of this controlled vocabulary; its definitions are attributed vocabulary descriptions, not original research claims.
notes: Explicit author revisions retain existing IDs, labels and kinds. Neutral reported/undated/frontier:false metadata leaves acceptance and chronology unresolved. Registry seed records are proposed as canonical sourced records under their existing IDs, without duplicate discoverable nodes. The registry-seed tag is removed explicitly on promotion; original representations retained in local audit and existing baseline/history. Taxonomy uses only captured category breadcrumbs or explicit branch definitions, never See also links. Revision 2 adds the NLM MeSH clinical Endocrinology scope note to resolve the independent reviewer's health-domain uncertainty. Original revision and all negative/uncertain decisions remain retained. Revision 3 explicitly includes the complete compiled records: legacy OECD reference citations and empty storage lists are preserved. USGS/NLM retained scope notes remain the evidence for the revised statements. Original candidates and review outcomes remain unchanged.
